changes: Pick up past chats with Omi or start a new one, delete chats you no longer need, and pull chat down to close it
Settings keeps the right colors after you switch between Light and Dark
The app opens in the light appearance from the very first frame unless you chose Dark or System
The Cloud button on Home is back to its filled circle with a count badge, and the badge stays black and white instead of turning orange while recordings wait on your Omi
Conversations open with a large title, Summary and Transcript tabs at the top, a transcript that reads like plain notes, and one bar at the bottom to play the recording or ask Omi
Device Diagnostics now shows reconnections and failed connections from the last 7 days, with lifetime totals alongside
Home and Tasks keep their empty-state icons and readable titles after loading, in light and dark mode. Home shows just the icon and title; Tasks explains how conversations create tasks.
Locked conversations now show a subtle frosted preview with a readable upgrade action in light and dark mode
See the screenshots from your meetings in the conversation summary, and open, share or delete them
Ask Omi keeps one continuous conversation when you reopen it, without separate past-chat or new-chat controls
People shows how sure Omi is about each voice and why, lets you pin the people you talk to most, and offers a Clean Up that removes misheard names in one pass
People in search now opens the same list as Settings, filtered by what you type, and each person opens their full page
Ask Omi with Siri using more phrases, and hear answers without opening chat
Conversations no longer show as Untitled: each one shows its first words, and a Retry button appears only when a failed summary can still be made

The voice card plays each clip with its words, ranks people by how close their voice is, lets you say who it is when it is someone else, marks TV and podcasts as Not a Person, and gives every answer a few seconds to undo

Free up phone storage: synced recordings can now be removed from your device 30 days after they're safely backed up, with cloud copies always kept. Existing users can turn it on in Offline Sync → Manage Storage.
Export All Data now downloads large accounts reliably, shows real progress, and can be cancelled
Opening a conversation, memory, or task from iPhone Search now goes to that item in Omi
Processing conversations now appear under their recording day's header on Home.
Maps on Home, in conversations and in daily recaps now match your light or dark appearance, in black and white with street names
Locked conversations in the list show the frosted preview only, without the old dark overlay on top.
Omi on iPhone now checks that pendant audio is arriving, tries to restore it when it stalls, and only shows Listening after audio arrives.

Pendant audio copies the saved transcript covers now stay on your phone under your auto-remove preference instead of uploading again, while copies it cannot provably account for are kept and uploaded for repair

Conversation pages show when the transcript is loading, failed to load, or is still being processed, show progress and a result for Reprocess, and report failed edits instead of silently undoing them.

Cleaner screens across onboarding, conversations, memories, chat, settings and device diagnostics: shorter copy, confirmations that say what happens, no overlapping headers, a memory list that never waits on the graph, and diagnostics that read normal reconnects as healthy.
People keeps known counts when a refresh is incomplete and lets you know when counts may be incomplete.
Follow the transcript while audio plays, scrub to jump between moments, and pick up playback from where you are reading
Conversation transcripts group each speaker's turn and show speaker counts only when voices can be reliably separated.
Fixed an Android startup crash when recording sync finishes or is cancelled immediately.
Offline Sync storage labels and counts are readable in light and dark appearance.
Voice introduction titles no longer overlap the onboarding back button.
Closing a voice suggestion card preserves its Undo window before saving the answer.
People Clean Up waits for freshly loaded confidence evidence before offering deletion candidates.
People confidence details correctly distinguish automatic text recognition from reviewed speaker labels.
Ignored voices remain manageable after conversation merges or when newer conversations have been deleted.
Speaker labels now show whether you confirmed them or Omi guessed, let you say "Not Me", "Not a Person" or reject a guess, and tell you after tagging whether the voice was learned.
Live voice suggestions now disappear or update when later audio changes the match.
Rapid People pin changes now save in order and recover correctly when a request fails.
Choosing Someone else on a pinned voice suggestion shows alternatives without selecting the rejected person.
Improved the reliability of voice learning when you label a speaker.
People selection and deletion now follow the current search and filter, and confirmations list the selected names.
Swipe a conversation to reveal a delete button with a small confirm menu, and see app updates in a cleaner sheet in your language.
Conversations without a title or transcript now show a localized date and time instead of Untitled Conversation.
